title: CI runs Gherkin and Playwright acceptance
description:
## Behavior

CI on develop must run the product specifications, not only unit lint.

```gherkin
Feature: Quality gates run the product specifications
  Scenario: CI runs Behave
    Given the CI workflow file
    Then a step runs behave on the features directory

  Scenario: CI runs Playwright acceptance
    Given the CI workflow file
    Then a step runs Playwright against the site
```

## Implementation brief

1. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: after Pytest, `python -m behave ../features` in `cli/`.
2. After Site build, install Chromium and `npx playwright test` in `site/`. Set `NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-ci` on the existing Next build so Playwright's `npm run dev` is not poisoned.
3. `features/quality_gates.feature` plus steps reading `ci.yml`.
4. Do not enable PyPI.
